Funnel-layout elements
Page footer

Sits at the bottom of every page and keeps its own colours, fonts and sizes.

Choose a box above to edit it.

A · Background

The funnel's page background — color and an optional image.

B · Logo

The header logo — sourced from the selected preview site's branding by default.

For a manual logo override, open the Header region on the canvas (Funnel builder tab) → Advanced.

C · Phone / URL

Placeable call/link buttons (header, under the header, bottom of the section, or the footer).

D · Disclosure

Per-location advertising-disclosure entries (top and bottom can coexist).

E · Free text

Author paragraph / heading / checklist blocks anywhere in the funnel chrome.

F · Brand logos

A row or grid of partner/trust logos, placed at a slot.

H · Images

Individually placed images (e.g. a persona portrait), each with its own slot, size, alignment and optional hover caption.

I · Progress

Shows visitors how far through the funnel they are.

Style

5 real styles (Bar/Dots/Numbered/Percent/Icon on track) — "Hidden" is the toggle below, not a 6th style.

The mark that travels along the track. Used by the “Icon on track” style.

Design

Aligns the progress unit within its width band (defaults to Center).

Progress counts the slides of this funnel variant automatically.

J · Footer

Bottom-of-page blocks (company details / links / disclosure / logo / address / socials / heading / list), with their own palette, font family and sizes — independent of the main template.

Palette & typography scope

Independent of the main template's font.
